Package expressionVisitors

Class Summary
DEditEVAttFinder Class which finds and returns as a Vector of DEditTagInfos, all attributes for the passed in Expression.
DEditEVData Class which finds the DEditDataType for a given Expression and returns it.
DEditEVExpression Class which finds the Expression corresponding to a passed in chain of Nodes and returns it
DEditEVIsLeaf Determines if visited Expression is a leaf in the XML tree.
DEditEVOptions Returns, as a Vector of DEditTagInfos, all possible children of the visited Expression.
DEditEVPrintout Class which prints out a representation of the passed in Expression and its children to standard out.
DEditEVRequired Retrieves, as a Vector of DEditTagInfo's, all required children of the visited Expression.
